gaps.term: modulus bound 2^k needs an initial bound
gaps.quote: a value lies in $2^{-(p+k)}\mathbb Z[i]$ and has modulus at most $2^k$
gaps.note: Missing hypothesis: the modulus bound 2^k holds only if the values at the start of the layer have modulus at most 1 (disk-valued, in 2^{-p}Z[i]). The page only says stored values lie on the grid 2^{-p}Z[i], which puts no bound on their modulus, so the induction (doubling per addition) has no base case. The paper (line 2563) says 'start with disk-valued coefficients in 2^{-p}Z[i]' before concluding depth l gives modulus at most 2^l. The page's later claim that Delta+3 integer bits suffice depends on this hypothesis.
